outlook.summary: Not financial advice — this is a personal tracking dashboard meant to organize publicly available information for research purposes. Always size positions and confirm with your own research.

strongest.area: AI-monetizing cloud and enterprise software, led by Amazon and Microsoft
strongest.reason: Amazon is extending its historic post-earnings surge and Microsoft keeps adding fresh enterprise deals and analyst conviction, both reinforcing the AWS/Azure acceleration story from last week
a freshly published threat-intelligence report on AI-embedded adversary activity is reinforcing the platform's relevance right after a guidance raise

weakest.area: Semiconductors heading into AMD's Aug 4 report
weakest.reason: fresh China memory-competition headlines are hitting Micron and renewed scrutiny of Nvidia's China exposure is adding noise ahead of a high-stakes earnings print
bitcoin and ethereum are both down again today, still consolidating well off recent highs in a broader risk-off pocket for digital assets

outlook.nextStep: AMD reporting tomorrow and Palantir reporting today after the close, alongside Friday's jobs report, make for an unusually concentrated run of catalysts this week — worth a closer look at how each print is received against already-elevated expectations. The Fed's rate path (now roughly 68% odds of a September hike, priced) is a bigger swing factor than any single stock's earnings and is better watched through Friday's jobs data than acted on ahead of it.

signals.title: Rate-hike odds firm up as Iran talks ease oil, jobs data looms
signals.body: Market pricing now shows roughly 68% odds of a September Fed hike, a reversal from more dovish expectations a few weeks ago, while reports that US-Iran talks will resume sent crude down sharply and left gold only modestly higher. Friday's jobs report is the next big data point.
signals.focus: better watched than acted on until Friday's jobs data

signals.title: Cloud-earnings glow extends into the new week
signals.body: Amazon and Microsoft are both extending last week's gains as analysts raise targets on the AWS/Azure acceleration story; Google is comparatively quiet after a pulled AI feature drew misinformation-risk criticism.
signals.focus: worth a closer look at how durable the cloud-acceleration narrative proves

signals.title: Chip sector stays shaky ahead of AMD's earnings
signals.body: Micron fell further on reports of a new Chinese DRAM competitor plant, and AMD slid again ahead of Tuesday's report, where options markets are pricing a roughly 12% move. ASML was a rare bright spot after a bullish analyst call.
signals.focus: better watched than acted on until AMD reports Tuesday

signals.title: Tesla rises despite a new NHTSA probe
signals.body: Tesla extended its gain even as regulators opened a suspension-related investigation into 1.2M vehicles, with one analyst trimming its target on FSD/robotaxi risk. Continued merger speculation appears to be offsetting the regulatory overhang for now.
signals.focus: worth a closer look at how the stock separates regulatory risk from merger speculation

signals.title: Palantir headlines a crowded earnings day
signals.body: Palantir reports after today's close on a day stacked with other high-profile results; some analysts caution the bar for a repeat positive reaction is high. ServiceNow and Salesforce both continue to grind higher on separate analyst and strategy news.
signals.focus: worth a closer look once tonight's results are in

signals.title: CrowdStrike's new threat report keeps cybersecurity in focus
signals.body: CrowdStrike's freshly published 2026 Threat Hunting Report finds AI now embedded across adversary operations, extending a strong run for the stock. Zscaler is also building on a new sovereign-cloud partnership in Europe.
signals.focus: worth a closer look given the fresh data behind the move
